statement: Interior $`C^{1,\alpha}`$ regularity for infinity-harmonic functions. Proves uniform interior $`C^{1,\alpha_d}`$ regularity for bounded infinity-harmonic functions in every dimension d ≥ 3, for a positive exponent depending only on dimension. The gradient's supremum norm and Hölder seminorm on the half unit ball are bounded by a dimension-dependent constant times the oscillation on the unit ball. The exponent is not explicit.
